bugs.description: Removes the null-conditional operator when accessing the Identifier property, causing a NullReferenceException if the syntax is not a PropertyDeclarationSyntax.
Inverts the condition that checks if the diagnostic is located in the current compilation, causing valid diagnostics to be dropped and invalid ones to be reported.
Uses defineSource instead of usageSource when creating the usage compilation, which will cause the test to compile the wrong code.
Changes the diagnostic severity check from >= Warning to > Warning, which would allow warnings to pass the test silently.
Falsely claims that members of a type defined in a referenced assembly are reported by the consuming project, contradicting the actual behavior implemented in the PR.
bugs.old: Members of a type defined in a referenced assembly are reported by the project that defines that type, so an unattributed public member of such a type must be fixed in its defining project.
bugs.new: Members of a type defined in a referenced assembly are reported by the project that consumes that type, so an unattributed public member of such a type must be fixed in its consuming project.

bugs.description: Swallows the compilation failure by removing the exception throw and instead just logging to the console, which will cause downstream failures when trying to use the invalid image.
